name: Nodagawa Miki
source:
Mama club member.

She is an office worker and continues to work after marriage and childbirth. Because of this, she rarely participates in the club and is treated as a rare character by the boys.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/mmc3.html]official site[/url]]
